title: Unlikely
subtitle: 「不太可能／令人懷疑／機會渺茫／難以置信」，究竟是哪一種 unlikely？
description: 「不太可能／令人懷疑／機會渺茫／難以置信」，究竟是哪一種 unlikely？

words.meaning: 不太可能的；發生概率低的
words.note: 使用者提供。improbable 是 unlikely 最直接、較正式的核心近義詞之一，主要表示某事件發生的概率很低。它比 unlikely 稍書面，常見於分析、研究和正式敘述。
words.example: A complete recovery within one day would be highly improbable.

exercises.original: It is unlikely that demand will double within a month.

exercises.upgrade: improbable · 不太可能的；發生概率低的

options.explanation: within a month + dramatic increase makes this a low-probability prediction, which suits formal improbable.

正式、分析性地表示發生概率低。 但本題的具體線索是 low chance because the attempt is very late；這句真正要表達的是「低勝算但仍可能一試」。因此 improbable 雖然與 unlikely 接近，概率強度、可信度、語域或句法功能並不最吻合。
表示說話者對是否會發生、是否為真或是否能成功抱有懷疑。 但本題的具體線索是 low chance because the attempt is very late；這句真正要表達的是「低勝算但仍可能一試」。因此 doubtful 雖然與 unlikely 接近，概率強度、可信度、語域或句法功能並不最吻合。
技術性風險／統計分類，表示低概率事件。 但本題的具體線索是 low chance because the attempt is very late；這句真正要表達的是「低勝算但仍可能一試」。因此 low-probability 雖然與 unlikely 接近，概率強度、可信度、語域或句法功能並不最吻合。
較口語，表示說法／情節牽強、過度誇張或難信。 但本題的具體線索是 low chance because the attempt is very late；這句真正要表達的是「低勝算但仍可能一試」。因此 far-fetched 雖然與 unlikely 接近，概率強度、可信度、語域或句法功能並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 低概率的；發生機率低的
words.note: 較技術、分析性。low-probability 常用於風險管理、統計、保險、工程和情境規劃，表示某事件發生機率低。它比 unlikely 更像分類標籤。
words.example: The model includes several low-probability, high-impact events.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；improbable 稍正式、分析性更強。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A sudden reversal is improbable. A sudden reversal is unlikely.

falseSynonyms.zh: doubtful 更帶說話者的懷疑／保留；unlikely 可以較中性地描述概率。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is doubtful that he remembers every detail. It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.

falseSynonyms.zh: remote 通常要搭配 chance/possibility，表示機會極小；不能機械替代所有 unlikely + noun。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There is a remote chance of success. Success is unlikely.

falseSynonyms.zh: implausible 主要評價說法、解釋或情境是否可信；不只是概率低。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His explanation is implausible. A delay is unlikely.

falseSynonyms.zh: far-fetched 更口語、更負面，表示牽強或誇張；一般預測不宜使用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The plot is far-fetched. A price rise is unlikely.

falseSynonyms.zh: impossible 是零可能／無法發生；unlikely 只是概率低，兩者強度不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is impossible to be in two places at once. It is unlikely that he will arrive early.

falseSynonyms.zh: unexpected 表示事情已發生但出乎意料，或不是原本預期；unlikely 是事前概率判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The result was unexpected. The result had seemed unlikely.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者是反義方向。likely 表較可能；unlikely 表較不可能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rain is likely this evening. Snow is unlikely.
